title: Friends in Europe – especially Netherlands
excerpt: I’ll be in Netherlands this September 13-14. You’ll find information here: Friday 13 September: https://www.godgeleerdheid.vu.nl/nl/nieuws-en-agenda/agenda/2019/jul-sep/190913-brian-mclaren-naar-de-vu.aspx English translation: http://www.frt.vu.nl/nl/nieuws-en-agenda/nieuwsarc…
body:
I’ll be in Netherlands this September 13-14. You’ll find information here:

 Friday 13 September:

 https://www.godgeleerdheid.vu.nl/nl/nieuws-en-agenda/agenda/2019/jul-sep/190913-brian-mclaren-naar-de-vu.aspx

 English translation:  http://www.frt.vu.nl/nl/nieuws-en-agenda/nieuwsarchief/2019/apr-jun/190612-brian-dmclaren-op-vrijdag-13-september-naar-de-vrije-universiteit-amsterdam.aspx

 Saturday 14 September:

 https://www.foundation.eu.com/single-post/2019/06/13/Foundation-Academy-of-Amsterdam-haalt-Brian-McLaren-naar-Nederland

 Dutch translation:  https://www.foundation.eu.com/single-post/2019/06/13/Foundation-Academy-of-Amsterdam-haalt-Brian-McLaren-naar-Nederland

  

 I’ll be in the UK and Paris before and after my time in Netherlands. Hope to see many of you then!
